note: Client risk-assessment settings. No money questions: every item is an everyday-life read on how much risk the person takes, on a 1-5 scale (1 very cautious, 3 no strong preference, 5 very bold). Questions are re-rolled in a fresh order every visit and the 5 options inside each are rotated too. 'type r' items are reversed (agreeing is cautious, so they score LOW when you agree) — they are what stop an always-agree clicker from looking bold. Distractors ('type d') carry weight 0. Bands are a team-parked starting table, not yet reviewed.
_record_endpoint_note: Paste your Google Apps Script web-app URL here to auto-log results to the team sheet. Leave empty for manual-code-only mode. Setup: team/SETUP.md
